Name: Swell Mods
Author: SwellWaters
Description:
[b][size=4]Install[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install GMCM here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*]Automatically number animals by order purchased, Auto-incubate and Auto-ship their products, and track your profits.[/*]
[*]Speed up or slow down you Stardew days.[/*]
[*]Automatically pass out at your desired times, fully configurable.[/*]
[*]Quickly empty mail if you slept too long.


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires GMCM for easy configurability.[/color]

[b][size=4]Compatibility [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/Mac/Windows.[/color][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Shout outs[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]Shout out to RandomComputerUser for kicking off this journey with their Gamespeed mod.[/color]
